# CMSIS SVD (debug only)

STM32H745 CM7/CM4 System View Description files from the ST CMSIS Device
Family Pack ([Open-CMSIS-Pack/STM32H7xx_DFP](https://github.com/Open-CMSIS-Pack/STM32H7xx_DFP)
`CMSIS/SVD/`). These are the same names CubeCLT ships. Apache-2.0.

`.vscode/launch.json` points here so the register view works without
`STM32CLT_PATH`. The files are not compiled into firmware.
